title: Iron Wok Jan Anime Reveals Main Trailer, Visual, July 5 Premiere, Tomokazu Sugita Cast as XO Sauce Ryu
content: The upcoming Iron Wok Jan TV anime revealed a new key visual, main trailer (behind-the-scenes version), and additional voice cast ahead of its July 5 premiere. Studio TROYCA is in charge of the animation.
author: Anime Corner

title: CyberAgent Reveals Anime Expo 2026 Plans, Including KAGURABACHI and The World Is Dancing
content: CyberAgent has announced its Anime Expo 2026 lineup, with the company’s Anime & IP Business Division set to exhibit at the Los Angeles convention from July 2 to July 5. title: Mixed Media Project 'Re:bel Robotica' Announces TV Anime Adaptation
content: Amuse Creative Studio announced a television anime adaptation of illustrator Mika Pikazo 's Re:bel Robotica mixed-media franchise on Wednesday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured). The teaser promotional video will be revealed at the Anime Expo 2026 convention on July 4.

title: The Hidden Dungeon Only I Can Enter Manga Listed to End in 17th Volume
content: The original version of this article reference a different manga adaptation based on Meguru Seto 's The Hidden Dungeon Only I Can Enter light novel series, instead of The Strongest Hero: Envoy of Darkness .

title: 2026’s Most Underrated Sci-Fi Anime Finally Confirms Home Release Date
content: 2026 has been one of the greatest years for anime fans, with exciting new series and film releases. The year is only halfway over, and fans have already been treated to some of the best anime in recent years.

title: Mika Pikazo's Re:bel Robotica Project Gets Anime
content: Amuse Creative Studio announced a new anime based on Mika Pikazo 's Re:bel Robotica mixed media project on Wednesday. Amuse Creative Studio will present teaser footage and more information about the anime at a panel in Anime Expo on July 4, and it will also have a booth at the convention.
author: ANN

title: Uchū Nanchara Kotetsu-kun: Space Academy Manga Gets Anime Film
content: Kadokawa announced on Wednesday that Yūji Nishimura 's web manga Uchū Nanchara Kotetsu-kun ( Space Academy ) will have an anime film titled Uchū Nanchara Kotetsu-kun : Ukkari Detekita Uchūjin o Sagase! ( Space Academy : Find the Aliens Who Accidentally Came Out!) that will open in Japan on September 11.
author: ANN

title: 'Sakamoto Days 2nd Season' Reveals New Staff, Additional Cast, Teaser Promo for Winter 2027
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Yuuto Suzuki 's Sakamoto Days manga revealed new staff, additional cast, a teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video for the second season on Wednesday. The second season is scheduled to premiere worldwide exclusively on Netflix in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Dandadan Reveals First Look At New Adaptation Ahead of Third Season
content: The acclaimed Shonen Jump+ manga, Dandadan , by Yukinobu Tatsu, was released five years ago on April 6th, 2021. The series has come a long way since then and reached new heights of popularity thanks to the incredible adaptation by Science SARU.
